lines.trans: I feel like I said far too many unnecessary things.
Please edit that part out for me.
Do you think broadcasting is a joke?
No, sir.
Do you know what work you will be doing today?
I heard our job is casting new members for the new season.
With only a week left before filming, they said hardly anyone will want to do it.
Then what do you do?
They say in a situation like this, we have to catch a chicken instead.
A chicken instead of a pheasant?
Yes, then I will head in to catch a chicken now.

meanings.note: Used colloquially for positive or negative emphasis.
Original sense of exceeding a limit.

examples.trans: The weather is so nice today.

meanings.en: a lot, much, in large quantity
meanings.note: Adverbial form of 많다 (to be many/much)

examples.trans: I did a lot of work today.
Please eat plenty and enjoy.

meanings.en: to do, to perform, to hold
meanings.note: Core verb; also combines with nouns to form verbs.

examples.trans: What are you doing right now?
We are holding a meeting today.

meanings.note: Bound noun often contracted to 거 in everyday speech.

examples.trans: This is my bag.
Because I think I'm late.

meanings.note: Used in -(으)ㄴ/는 것 같다 to express 'it seems that...' or 'I think...'.

meanings.en: to be the same, to be like
meanings.note: Compares two things with -와/과 같다.

examples.trans: I think I'm late.
It looks like it's going to rain.

meanings.note: Standard polite negative reply.

examples.trans: No, I'm okay.

meanings.note: The present day; often used adverbially without a particle.

examples.trans: The weather is nice today.
What day of the week is it today?

meanings.note: Placed directly before a noun in questions

examples.trans: What kind of music are you listening to right now?

가보다.gloss: to go and see; to visit

meanings.en: to go and check; to go see
meanings.note: Compound of 가다 ('to go') + 보다 ('to see/try').
Often used in past tense 가 봤다 for experiential meaning.

examples.trans: I'll have to go see for myself.
Have you ever been to Jeju Island?

meanings.note: Used for time or order.
